resolvedFindings.resolution: Inventory omits explicit string --manifest so stock XPCShellRunner selects the checked generated global manifest. Directory filtering remains the ordinary stock testPaths input.
The MozbuildObject receives a real LoggingManager before spawning the stock runner; enable/disable and global class restoration are protected.

resolvedFindings.origin: owner and peer fixed-source dependency review
resolvedFindings.resolution: The obsolete manifest generated-files entry does not create a required installed unit/xpcomtest.xpt. The gate now reads the actual config/makefiles/xpidl/xpcomtest.xpt intermediate JSON, binds its two fixed interface names/UUIDs through the stable descriptor, and never creates or copies a dummy runtime file. Actual compiled Ci registration still requires the unchanged test_notxpcom_scriptable.js to pass.

resolvedFindings.origin: independent source review and owner fault controls
resolvedFindings.resolution: Case evidence is attached before filesystem setup. Setup, launch, parsing and post-source binding are protected. Primary launch failure, collection failure and receipt-write failure remain separate; private errors/raw stage evidence do not replace returned safe evidence. Nested monitor observation is captured before projection and drives pipeline monitor-inconclusive.

Every nested status value is an exact nonnegative integer with an exact enum keyset. The complete test-end distribution equals PASS/known FAIL/SKIP expectations with all other statuses zero. Unexpected failure counters are zero, subtest sums match and total skips include separately retained subtest skips.

inventoryContract.requiredActualScopeSelection: Exactly the 45 fixed source IDs; no missing, duplicate or foreign ID may satisfy scope proof.
stockSelectionPreserved: stock default filters and strict expressions
inventoryContract.exitProof: Dump SystemExit must be None or exact int0, with both suppressed hook events, no server handles and testCount exact zero. Ordinary return or missing/partial dump is rejected.
inventoryContract.temporaryPrefs: Stock object temp directory is retained and accurately labeled; no claim that stock removed a caller-owned object temp directory.

selectionAndOutcomeContract.execution: stock mach xpcshell-test, directory scope, explicit built binary, sequential threads1, verbose and no automatic retry key
selectionAndOutcomeContract.expectedStatusSource: Actual fixed-source inventory output, not Linux fixture numbers or a predeclared Mac skip total.
selectionAndOutcomeContract.PASS: Only actual PASS test ends count as passed.
selectionAndOutcomeContract.manifestSKIP: Expected disabled records retain actual SKIP, count as selected/skipped and do not count as executed/PASS.
selectionAndOutcomeContract.knownFAIL: A complete expected FAIL remains actual FAIL and a separate expectedFailures count; it is not rewritten to PASS.
selectionAndOutcomeContract.unknown: Unreadable, malformed, partial, duplicate or mismatched evidence keeps counts null and fails qualification.
selectionAndOutcomeContract.completeLifecycle: All 45 selected IDs must be uniquely listed, started and ended once in one complete suite. Raw lifecycle, per-test status map and aggregate counts must agree.

nativeAndResourcePreparation.nativeChecks: Owned executable, resolved inside object root, fresh current-job mtime, x86_64 Mach-O executable identity, hash/sections/UUID. The real XPIDL intermediate is read through the owned stable descriptor reader and its exact two interface name/UUID pairs are required.
nativeAndResourcePreparation.compiledInterfaceRuntimeProof: The unchanged test_notxpcom_scriptable.js is included in the exact 45-record real harness selection and must satisfy its expected result.

pipelineAndSafety.HTTP2: Stock assume-node switch remains the preexisting deliberate no-HTTP2 path; this scope does not qualify HTTP2 behavior.
pipelineAndSafety.HTTP3: Stock startup remains in the monitored case process group for actual execution; only listing suppresses it.

privacyAndEvidence.inventoryRawAbsolutePaths: Private dump only; returned global inventory contains numeric aggregates and hashes.
privacyAndEvidence.publicTestIds: Only the fixed 45 source-relative scope IDs and fixed PASS/FAIL/SKIP enums.
privacyAndEvidence.returnedExceptions: Fixed allowlisted code or class; arbitrary exception text remains private.

remainingExecutionConditions: Calling workflow and immutable route are not covered by this code-only result and require their separate typed gate/pin review.
Actual Mac installed global population, scope enabled/SKIP status, native helper/IPC installation and 45-record complete execution remain untested until the proposed real job runs.
Fresh normal SDK/checkpoint origin and expiry checks, nonoverlap and ordinary owned cleanup remain required at admission.
Success would qualify only the fixed manifest scope and existing controls, not the entire upstream population, complete stock host build, package or native authentication.

testOnlyRebind.change: Canonicalize the test TemporaryDirectory Path with resolve(), so a macOS /var alias resolves to its canonical directory.
testOnlyRebind.interveningIncorrectCwdRun: One full run from the repository root had an existing subprocess import error and is excluded from success evidence. The corrected QA-directory run is the bound final full result.
